title: ID0391128-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / P4 170000365] Outlet not ready
description:

Outlet not ready
Root cause: XD10.3B/A not inserted properly

additional_info.body: We have the error Voltage transducer has lifesign zero check fault but it's sporadic, it's not a permanent solution. A deep analysis on the contactors, voltage transducer and StateMonitor is necessary.

Hello Rasmus,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Harm Mammen & Sønner A/S
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P4 170000365
Charger ID/Serial No.:
25MN0C
Problem Description:
Outlet not ready
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 04/07/20224, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Based on our analysis, we found that the
PLC-Error-Flag 'HVT_TF2' changed
error is toggling between true and false multiple times. We suggest you check the following wirings:
There are maybe two possible reasons:
The device is broken --> If so, then need to replace it.
The feedback line to analog input KF7 is broken (output 2V=0V at DC...10V=1000V at DC)
Kindly check above loose wiring connection or damaged with safety guidelines.
Based on our analysis, we found that the QA15-16 coil is stuck in the ON feedback position. We suggest you check the following:
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.

additional_info.subject: ID0391128-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / P4 170000365] Outlet not ready CRM:00642001815
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
After yesterday's site visit we were able to remove the error HVT_TF2 from the charger. I cannot confirm but my suspicion is that the XD10.3 was not inserted correctly because you installed a new KF7 and TF2 and the error was still present.
Since yesterday the error hasn't triggered.
From my side, I can keep proactively monitoring the charger until Monday and if there is no more error I will declare as XD10.3 to be the root cause.
Let me know if you have any other opinion.
Best regards,
Francisco
